summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that its board granted 29,380 employee warrants on September 8, 2026, each exercisable for one ordinary share at US$270.09, the grant-date closing price. Vesting is 25% at one year, then 1/36th monthly, with exit-event acceleration. The company amended its Articles of Association to authorize the grants, leaving 1,495,063 shares available for future grant. No deal, capital return, or control event is involved; the filing is routine equity-compensation disclosure. Watch only for dilution and future grant pace.
